description: PowerFlows.jl, published by Sienna-Platform, provides interfaces to multiple power-flow solution methods, starting from the solver formerly in PowerSystems.jl. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is BSD-3-Clause. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The README says the package is under development and its API will change. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: The README places it in the SIIP/Sienna initiative, but platform-sienna does not explicitly name this extracted package.
